description: Ex-SAAF medium transport helicopter displayed at the School of Tactical Intelligence, Potchefstroom, an SA Army training unit. The current Unofficial SAAF Website list places it here; the same site's 2017 version gave the location as GSB Potchefstroom, so the unit name changed but the airframe stayed at Potchefstroom. Not checked on satellite imagery; the site coordinate is a geocoded unit polygon, not a fix on the helicopter.
aliases: SA-330L Puma;SA330L Puma;Sud Aviation Puma;Aerospatiale SA 330 Puma
